final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT a.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3), s2 AS (SELECT region, AVG(account_count) AS region_avg FROM s1 GROUP BY region), s3 AS (SELECT s1.district_id, s1.region, s1.account_count, s1.account_count - s2.region_avg AS difference FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s1.region = s2.region COLLATE BINARY WHERE s1.account_count > s2.region_avg), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(account_count) AS overall_avg FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT CAST(s3.account_count AS REAL) / s4.overall_avg AS ratio FROM s3 CROSS JOIN s4 WHERE s4.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT s3.district_id, s3.region, s3.account_count, s3.difference, CAST(s3.account_count AS REAL) / s4.overall_avg AS ratio FROM s3 CROSS JOIN s4 WHERE s4.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s3.account_count AS REAL) / s4.overall_avg >= (SELECT MIN(ratio) FROM s5) ORDER BY ratio DESC
